name: Lazarus Shelf Street Clinic RipDoc Full Rig
description: A full-length butcher-gray apron over salvaged olive scrubs, both stained with chromatic fluid and sealed with peel-strip biohazard patches. Cracked visor headset holds three mismatched magnification lenses taped into a single rig. Knee-high rubber overboots seal over the scrubs, and nitrile-coated gauntlets extend past the wrist with grip-textured fingertips. A chest harness of repurposed cargo webbing holds scalpel rolls, syringe loops, and a portable neural-clamp bracket.
functionality: Fluid-resistant apron and sealed overboots protect against blood and coolant splash; tool harness keeps surgical implements within one-handed reach during solo procedures.
what_it_says: This person has kept people alive in conditions that would shut down a licensed clinic, and they've done it without asking for credentials.
story_hooks: A fresh neural port on the apron's shoulder strap suggests the doc recently performed self-surgery — the sutures are still visible.
The cracked visor has a hand-scratched serial number that matches a stolen Lazarus MedCore diagnostic unit reported missing six months ago.
